en.what: A small tool over your workplace, its conditions declared as data.
checks: your folder holds `rule.txt` (one condition, such as `{ @item > 20 }`), `data.txt` (one number per line) and `tool.ring`
the guard runs `tool.ring` with `$cProjectFolder` set to your folder
the tool prints `rule: ` followed by the rule it read from `rule.txt`, and `count: ` followed by how many lines of the data satisfy it

fr.what: Un petit outil sur votre lieu de travail, ses conditions déclarées comme des données.
checks: votre dossier contient `rule.txt` (une condition, par exemple `{ @item > 20 }`), `data.txt` (un nombre par ligne) et `tool.ring`
la garde exécute `tool.ring` avec `$cProjectFolder` pointant sur votre dossier
l'outil affiche `rule: ` suivi de la règle lue dans `rule.txt`, et `count: ` suivi du nombre de lignes des données qui la satisfont

checks: يحوي مجلدك `rule.txt` (شرطًا واحدًا مثل `{ @item > 20 }`) و`data.txt` (رقمًا في كل سطر) و`tool.ring`
يشغّل الحارس `tool.ring` مع `$cProjectFolder` مضبوطًا على مجلدك
تطبع الأداة `rule: ` يتبعها الشرط الذي قرأته من `rule.txt`، و`count: ` يتبعها عدد سطور البيانات التي تحققه

ha.what: Ƙaramin kayan aiki a kan wurin aikinka, sharuɗɗansa an bayyana su a matsayin bayanai.
checks: babban fayil ɗinka yana ɗauke da `rule.txt` (sharaɗi ɗaya, kamar `{ @item > 20 }`), `data.txt` (lamba ɗaya a kowane layi) da `tool.ring`
mai tsaro yana gudanar da `tool.ring` da `$cProjectFolder` ya nuna babban fayil ɗinka
kayan aikin yana buga `rule: ` sannan dokar da ya karanta daga `rule.txt`, da `count: ` sannan layukan bayanai nawa suka cika ta

ha.what: Rahoto a kan fayil na bayanai na gaske, mai siffofi, tebur da hoto.
